item.title: EEMUA launches e-learning course on refrigerated liquefied gas storage tanks
item.description: EEMUA has expanded its e-learning portfolio with the release of a new course on refrigerated liquefied gas storage tanks.

item.title: SEFE signs HoA with Southern Energy
item.description: SEFE Securing Energy for Europe and Southern Energy have signed a heads of agreement for an eight-year LNG supply deal.

item.title: MSA Safety launches the Gas Detection Hub: A new go-to resource for safety professionals
item.description: MSA Safety, Inc. has announced the launch of the Gas Detection Hub, a brand-new digital knowledge platform designed to help safety professionals move beyond reactive risk management and create a proactive, insight-led safety culture.

item.title: Eni launches the Phase 2 of Congo LNG ahead of schedule
item.description: Eni has launched Phase 2 ahead of the Congo LNG project ahead of the planned schedule, with the goal of exporting the first LNG cargo in early 2026.

item.title: WinGD and OPearl LNG Ship Management sign 15-year service deal for fleet reliability
item.description: WinGD has signed a long-term service agreement with OPearl LNG Ship Management to ensure optimal engine performance, reliability, and efficiency of LNG carriers.

item.title: ClassNK issues AiP to Nihon Shipyard and Hankuk Carbon
item.description: ClassNK has issued an approval in principle for a spray form insulation system of IMO Type B tank for LNG and ammonia fuel developed by Nihon Shipyard Co., Ltd and Hankuk Carbon Co., Ltd.

item.title: Eni signs long-term LNG sale agreement with BOTAS
item.description: Eni has entered a long-term LNG sale agreement with BOTAS to supply 0.4 million tpy of LNG.

item.title: Newbuild LNG vessels for QatarEnergy named
item.description: Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha, Ltd has held a naming ceremony for two 174 000 m3 LNG vessels for QatarEnergy at HD Hyundai Heavy Industries Co., Ltd.

item.title: Squadron Energy chooses Reganosa to operate and maintain new LNG terminal in Australia
item.description: Reganosa Servicios has been chosen by Squadron Energy to operate and maintain the onshore part of the Port Kembla Energy Terminal, New South Wales, Australia.

item.title: Axpo and GNV complete first ship-to-ship bio-LNG refuelling in Italy
item.description: Axpo and GNV supported by the Maritime Authority of Genoa, have completed Italy's first ship-to-ship bio-LNG bunkering operation at the Port of Genoa.
